title: CI Test Result Transitions
description: Output of 06_extract_ci_history.py for the test-transitions stream (companion to ci_runs.json). Records per-test transitions between consecutive runs on the default branch: pass-to-fail (regression candidates) and pass-to-skip (suppression candidates). The producer emits transitions with the canonical field names defined here; consumers (09_compute_metrics.py) MUST validate this artifact at load time to detect drift between extractor and compute. Aligned with AAP §0.5.3.12 (Metric 11). The github_api availability flag lives in the sibling ci_runs.json artifact; this artifact carries only the transition array plus a per-HEAD skip-scan snapshot.

kind.description: Canonical transition kind. 'regression' = pass-to-fail sustained for ≥FLAKY_THRESHOLD consecutive runs. 'suppression' = test newly marked skipped/disabled.

transitioned_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the run where the transition was first observed.

flaky_excluded.description: Tests that alternated within FLAKY_THRESHOLD runs and were excluded from regression counts.
